_설명: 『運転手のくせに』 PHASE 4 키프레임 i: 1컷 x 후보 2장 = 2장, 약 0.08달러. 생성: scripts/build_untenshu_keyframes.py (스토리보드 keyframe_prompt + 시트 칸 참조).

characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still — one frame only, NOT a grid. Reference images: the people's faces, hair and clothes must match their reference images exactly (same person); Photorealistic live-action Japanese TV drama, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, restrained Japanese film mise-en-scene, natural lived-in detail, no flat lighting. From outside on the sidewalk, looking through the rain-beaded rear side window of the glossy black taxi: inside, exactly two blurred passengers — a heavy-set man in a grey suit and a young woman in a beige trench coat — settling side by side into the back seat; only the driver's navy cap is glimpsed in front; neon bokeh reflected on the wet glass and black door. No other people. Characters: Otsuka Koji, a thickset Japanese man aged 45, a broad ruddy face, thick heavy black eyebrows, black hair stiffly gelled with a hard side parting, clean-shaven, no glasses, a gold wristwatch on his LEFT wrist, wearing a grey pinstripe business suit with the loud red paisley necktie loosened, jacket rumpled and damp from the rain, seen only from behind, face not visible | Ogawa Yui, a slim Japanese woman aged 26, a kind gentle oval face with natural light makeup, soft brown shoulder-length hair tied in a low ponytail with soft side-swept bangs, no glasses, wearing a plain beige trench coat over a plain navy trouser suit, seen only from behind, face not visible. People look like real Japanese drama actors photographed on set: real skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, natural matte skin, restrained believable expressions, bare unadorned earlobes and no jewellery. The taxi has a plain green license plate with no characters and a plain white dome roof lamp with no characters. Camera: eye-level from the side or behind, 35mm lens, f/4.0, environmental storytelling, balanced composition. Lighting: rainy Tokyo night, wet asphalt mirroring teal traffic lights and amber sodium street lamps, rain streaks backlit, mid-tones readable. Exactly 2 people as described, no extra people. The speaker's mouth is never visible (back view, bowed head, mirror crop, silhouette or angle). All papers, screens, signs, cards and labels are completely blank; no letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the frame. Any car license plate is a plain green plate with a thin white border and no characters; any taxi roof lamp is a plain white dome with no characters. Negative: gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, signage lettering, kanji on lanterns, posters with writing, documents with writing, screens with text, printed labels, brand logos, characters on license plates, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, blood, gore, police. CAMERA: from the side or behind — NOT facing the camera. The person marked 'seen only from behind' shows only the back of the head and shoulders; the face is NOT visible at all. Every paper, document, card, screen, meter display, license plate and roof lamp surface is completely blank and clean: NO characters, NO numbers (Japanese text is composited later). Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox.
